name: Mochigase (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Mochigase town emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Mochigase in Tottori Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01.

features.role: Mochigase town emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
